name: mutation
description: Mutates covered functions, reruns the tests, and warns where a mutated copy still passes, naming each surviving mutation.

settings.description: untracked repository paths Mutation copies into its working copy, such as a virtual environment or node_modules
the time budget of a Mutation run in minutes, above 0; a run that reaches it stops and keeps what it measured
settings.default_text: no time budget: the run continues until it finishes
settings.label: Stop a run after

settings.description: the most mutants tested at once, at least 1
settings.default_text: sized from the machine's cores and free memory
settings.label: Workers

settings.description: how many times a mutant may run longer than the unmutated suite before it counts as timed out, above 0; default 10
settings.label: Timeout

settings.description: whether a run measures only what changed since the last record; default true
settings.label: Only what changed

settings.description: where the sensor keeps what it has measured, relative to the repository; default .recognizer/cache/mutation/record.json
where the sensor writes the mutants that survived, relative to the repository; default .recognizer/cache/mutation/survivors.json
where the sensor writes its overlay, relative to the repository; default .recognizer/cache/overlays/mutation.json

metrics.name: killed
metrics.label: kill
metrics.title: Killed mutants
metrics.help: How many mutated copies of the function the tests caught.

metrics.name: survived
metrics.label: surv
metrics.title: Survived mutants
metrics.help: How many mutated copies of the function the tests let through.

metrics.name: uncovered
metrics.label: unc
metrics.title: Uncovered mutants
metrics.help: How many possible mutations fall on lines no test runs.

metrics.name: score
metrics.label: mut
metrics.title: Mutation score
metrics.help: The share of mutated copies of the function the tests caught.

group.name: Mutations
group.means: Recognizer changed this function's code and no test failed, so the tests do not pin its behaviour.
group.todo: Add a test that fails when this function's behaviour changes.

findings.help: One finding per function with at least one surviving mutation.
